QuestInfo.name: Top Hats and Tigers 2
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann needs help one more time.
QuestInfo.1: The Baby White Tiger is getting hungry. Get some Delicious Grass and Red Dragon Turtle Meat from the Dragon Forest.

0.0: My little baby tiger is so strong and smart! I LOVE HIM SO MUCH! He's super hungry though... did NOT plan for that one. Think you could help out?

yes.0: I can't feed him just anything. Believe me, I've tried. But he seems to like Red Dragon Turtle meat and Delicious Grass from Thorny Vines. Sounds like a trip to the Dragon Forest is in your future!

no.0: You must be heartless. Have you seen how cute he is?!

item.0: Could you speed it up? He gets really crazy when he's hungry. Remember, Dragon Forest!
